description:
Lists every agenda saved in the signed-in BriefMe account, newest first, with the
share_token every other tool takes.

Useful at the start of a conversation when the user refers to an agenda made earlier ("run
last week's sprint planning again"), and after create_agenda reports the account is full.

Returns limit, retained and slots_left alongside the agendas. It returns share links
only — the private control link comes from create_agenda.
name: list_agendas

blocks.description: Block count only; call get_agenda for the blocks.

limit.description: Agendas the account may keep. null means no ceiling.

title: List the account's agendas
